messages:
Riya (sales): Heads-up: MunicipalBank wants a 1-paragraph explainer for their CISO: who does what in an incident, notification timing we can offer for enterprise, and how we hand off logs/artifacts during a POC. Need something short I can paste.

Jon (security): Paste-ready bullets: customer = controller; Redwood = processor for hosted/dedicated. Private/VPC customers keep IR lead.

Jon (security): What we do: monitoring, detect & triage, contain & remediate, provide interim updates, and deliver a forensic evidence package.

Priya (solutions): Deployment nuance: Hosted/Dedicated = we can execute fixes, rotate creds, and export traces/logs. Private/VPC = customer runs IR; Redwood supplies runbooks, export scripts, and support access.

Chris (legal): Legal note: we provide evidence and a vendor incident statement. We do not file with regulators on the customer's behalf. Standard contract language: "notify without undue delay" + optional SLA appendix in enterprise addendum.

Jon (security): Suggested enterprise operational targets (only contractual if added to SLA): ack to POC: 1 hour (24/7 for confirmed critical incidents); initial summary: 4 hours; containment/mitigation started: 24 hours; forensic report for Critical: within 72 hours; logs/exports (hosted/dedicated): delivered via secure transfer within 48 hours after scope agreement. Private: ETA depends on customer environment and access.

Riya (sales): Can I offer that timeline to the CISO if they sign the addendum?

Chris (legal): Yes, include severity definitions, data types scope, access rights for forensic work, mutual cooperation obligations, and carve-outs for third-party/legal delays.

Jon (security): Short copy for email: "Redwood operates as your processor: for hosted and dedicated deployments we detect, triage, and remediate incidents and will notify affected customers per an agreed cadence (acknowledgement ~1h, initial summary ~4h, forensic package for critical events within 72h). For Private/VPC installations you retain incident leadership; Redwood will provide logs, export tools, and advisory support. Raw logs are shared only over secure channels and only after appropriate agreements (DPA/SoA). We can attach a draft enterprise addendum and a SIG/CAIQ control mapping if useful"

Priya (solutions): Add escalation snippet for SOC: IR-bot: incident created -> pager to on-call -> triage 30m -> POC ack 1h -> exec notif if unresolved >12h.

Riya (sales): Thanks — sending now. DM if any phrasing needs to change.

IR-bot: Internal playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/incident-response
